scope: Source/protocol investigation. Physical 0.20 scene verification remains pending; final CI results are recorded separately.

protocol.publication: Low/high value words relaxed, completion sequence release, then native notify; original engine address/sequence protocol preserved.

requiredTypes.1: D3D11_QUERY_OCCLUSION: actual UINT64 samples passing tests
requiredTypes.5: D3D11_QUERY_OCCLUSION_PREDICATE: canonical BOOL from actual zero/nonzero count

backend.change: MTLVisibilityResultMode::Boolean -> Counting at one pinned begin_query site
backend.capability: Require actual Metal device Apple3 or Mac2 support before creating a count/predicate query. A18 is Apple9 in Apple's feature table; hardware checked at runtime.
backend.wgpuFeature: Occlusion is core query support, not an optional timestamp feature. No adapter limits are raised.

boundedResources.notes: Payload excludes driver alignment/overhead. Pages allocated lazily and reused only after map/unmap completion. No whole-frame/archive caching.

ordering: Begin/End split physical passes without per-query queue waits.
Each physical segment resolves and copies outside its render pass, before a later pass can affect the visibility buffer; mapping follows the matching encoder submission.
Map only after that draw encoder is submitted, never after an unrelated submit.
Scopes sum segments across pass/submit boundaries; overlapping scopes share correct actual intervals.
Token changes cancel old reuse generations. Completion jobs retain IDs/tokens, never Object pointers or result addresses.
Destroy retires tokens before a destruction-triggered flush can publish callbacks.
Stop cancels maps; callback contexts remain alive through instance release; unfinished scopes never publish a fabricated completion.
Existing event completion and CPU timestamp/disjoint shim are retained, explicitly not real GPU timing.

performance.mappingBatch: One map per submitted nonempty page, up to64segments; per-pass resolves/copies retained after rejecting an incorrect batching experiment.
performance.backpressure: Only if all four pages are busy; cancelable bounded timeout, explicitly counted.
performance.idlePolling: Two-millisecond poll only while query maps are pending; original100ms sleep otherwise.

remainingQueries.timestamp2_disjoint3: Existing CPU-monotonic estimate retained; no GPU timestamp claim.
remainingQueries.pipeline_statistics4_and_stream_output: Explicit unsupported errors; no evidence they are the current Prologue requirement.

cleanupFinding.reproduction: Second candidate compiled, then query cleanup aborted: Cannot remove a vacant resource. QuerySetDestroy and final QuerySetRelease both call query_set_drop in this pinned version.
cleanupFinding.fix: Release the exclusively owned public query-set reference once; submitted command buffers retain internal references. Do not call QuerySetDestroy before final Release.
cleanupFinding.shutdownLimit: Query cleanup cancels maps and polls without an added completion wait. Existing pinned native WGPUDeviceImpl drop itself calls PollType::wait_indefinitely; full device teardown is not promised nonblocking.

definedCountWrap: D3D11 functional spec20.4.6 requires UINT64 modulo wrap. Unsigned addition is defined; predicate uses any nonzero segment rather than accumulated sum, preserving visibility across wrap.

sampleMaskFinding.reproduction: Fourth CI candidate produced1024 MSAA samples where a partial fixed mask required512.
sampleMaskFinding.fix: Explicitly reject masks disabling relevant samples; masks with all relevant bits set remain supported. Two negative MSAA fixtures guard the boundary. No fake counts or skipped required rendering.
